correctness.rationale: Saleh–Titz Mite–Witzel Section 4, Proposition 4.2 identifies the G-invariant complement Y=X minus ten maximal distance-three tetrahedra and gives Y ≃ VR<=2(D) ≃ S2. Their Proposition 4.4 proves each boundary [∂τ] is a unit generator of H2(Y;Z). The relative integral long exact sequence is 0 -> H3(X) -> Z[T] -> Z -> 0. Reorient relative tetrahedron generators so each maps to +u. A5 has no sign characters and hence fixes u; central antipodal inversion fixes no simplex of VR<=2 because antipodal pairs have graph distance 5. Lefschetz number 0 on a connected S2-homology complex gives its H2 sign -1, transferred to Y by equivariant inclusion, so G acts on normalized relative basis as δ(g) times the tetrahedral permutation. Its kernel is exactly δ tensor ker(augmentation), an integral lattice identity. Independent BFS enumeration found exactly ten pairwise-distance-three tetrahedra; generator closure gave 60 A5 rotations, 120 full automorphisms, two 5-element rotation orbits exchanged by inversion, confirming rational plus/minus dimensions 5 and 4 and the rank-one fixed orbit-difference line.
